g.text: Hey Lettie, how'd you get into being a medic?
Hey, Lettie, what brought you to Höllvania?
I didn't really have a choice.
I'm clearly bugging you, I'll leave you alone.
Then we have that in common
And you shouldn't ask stupid questions, babas
It's not like I'm busy or anything
What should I talk to you about instead?
Just trying to be friendly, sorry.
Didn't get much sleep last night
So I don't have much patience for bad questions
Didn't get much sleep last night
They *were* bad questions, though. lol. I just don't know what else to talk about
If you're gonna interrupt my day
Or are you just killing time
You did better with the question about the rats
Just trying to say hello, is all.
I just wanted to see how you were doing.
Make it interesting. Roger. I'll... go... think up... interesting things...
You did better with the question about home
Going to get back to it
Convince the locals to stop getting in between Techrot and scaldra
